Initial release: Create and export custom alarm clock videos with minimal setup or editing experience required.

- Upload video clips or images (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG; up to 500MB) for instant alarm clock video creation.
- Simple cloud-based workflow: auto-connects, manages session, and notifies users of progress.
- Supports adding alarm clock sound effects and text overlays for polished promotional content.
- Efficient export workflow: outputs 1080p MP4 video in 30–60 seconds, with quick download link.
- Friendly error handling for file, credit, or connection issues, and easy step-by-step guidance.
